structured.description: The Rippa R06 ECO is an ultra-compact mini excavator, ideal for tight job sites, landscaping, indoor work, and precise operations in confined spaces. Despite its small footprint, it delivers excellent stability, accessibility, and reliable performance for daily use. Powered by a reliable Kubota diesel engine, the R06 ECO offers smooth operation, low fuel consumption, and long service life. With a digging depth of 1001 mm and an operating weight of 747 kg, it is perfectly suited for narrow passages, backyards, and sensitive environments.

The R10 ECO is a powerful and versatile mini excavator, perfect for construction, landscaping, and private projects. Thanks to its flexible configuration options, it can be adapted to your specific needs.

The Rippa R13 PRO is a powerful and compact mini excavator, ideal for construction projects, landscaping, and precise work in confined spaces. With its combination of power, efficiency, and maneuverability, it is the perfect all-rounder for versatile applications. Equipped with a reliable Kubota diesel engine, the R13 PRO impresses with smooth operation, low fuel consumption, and long service life. With a digging depth of 2.10 meters and an operating weight of 1,300 kg, it easily handles demanding tasks.

The Rippa R15 ECO is a powerful and versatile mini excavator, ideal for construction projects, landscaping, and precise work in confined spaces. With its robust design and efficient Kubota diesel engine, it offers the perfect combination of power, reliability, and efficiency. With an operating weight of 1,500 kg and a digging depth of 1.87 meters, the R15 ECO is perfectly equipped for demanding tasks and stands out for its high stability and operator comfort. Standard features include: ✔ 40 cm toothed bucket for precise digging ✔ Fuel-efficient Kubota diesel engine (Euro 5 certified) ✔ Durable construction for maximum longevity ✔ Compact design for versatile applications. Additional accessories, such as various buckets, grapples, or quick couplers, can be found in the "Accessories" section on our website.
